name: singlet_disease_clinical_malignant_cell_identification
title: Malignant cell identification in tumour scRNA-seq
description: Labels each cell of a tumour sample as malignant or non-malignant and writes a malignant probability when the method provides one. The default classifier scores expression features with a catalogue-trained model; copykat, scevan and numbat add copy-number evidence; ikarus uses tumour signatures. Needs raw counts and gene coordinates; numbat also needs allele counts. Do not use on normal-only samples or to assign subclones; use the genetics tools for those.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Malignant caller. classifier is the default; numbat requires allele inputs.

normal_reference.description: auto uses obs/is_normal_reference when set, then immune or stromal labels in obs/cell_type; otherwise copykat and scevan build a synthetic diploid baseline.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for stochastic steps, such as copykat MCMC segmentation.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

copykat.description: Options for method copykat; ignored by other methods.

min_genes_per_cell.description: Cells with fewer detected genes are dropped before CNV scoring.

ngene_chr.description: Minimum genes per chromosome for a cell to pass filtering.

win_size.description: Minimum window size for segmentation (CopyKAT win.size).

ks_cut.description: Segmentation sensitivity (CopyKAT KS.cut); larger values give looser criteria.

scevan.description: Options for method scevan; ignored by other methods.

beta_vega.description: VegaMC segmentation parameter; higher values give coarser segments.

par_cores.description: Number of cores used by SCEVAN.

fixed_normal_cells.description: Keep the supplied normal cells as a fixed reference; intended for clonal-structure analyses.

numbat.description: Options for method numbat; ignored by other methods.

t.description: HMM switch probability between copy states.

gamma.description: Numbat gamma parameter from the source defaults.

min_llr.description: Minimum log-likelihood ratio used in Numbat segment calls.

max_iter.description: Maximum iterations of Numbat's inference loop.

tumour_posterior_threshold.description: A cell whose tumour posterior exceeds this value is called malignant.

ncores.description: Number of cores used by Numbat.

ikarus.description: Options for method ikarus; ignored by other methods.

n_neighbors.description: Neighbours in the kNN graph used for label propagation.

certainty_threshold.description: Initial certainty percentile for seed cells.

classifier.description: Options for method classifier; ignored by CNV methods.

decision_threshold.description: A cell with malignant probability at or above this value is called malignant.

C.description: Inverse L2 regularisation strength of the logistic head.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/malignant_label. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, n_cells, n_malignant, malignant_fraction, decision_threshold, normal_reference_source.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
